The wallet looks for its coins in the blocks from this date on. A phrase that received coins before Bitcoin Cash split from Bitcoin on August 1, 2017 needs an earlier date, and earlier dates take longer to scan.
Backing up your wallet is the only way to restore your funds if you ever lose access to your device.
All you need is a paper and pen to jot down your recovery phrase. When you\'re ready, continue to the next step.
Let\'s test you to make sure you\'ve written it down correctly.
Enter the following words from your recovery phrase.
Step 1: Download Orbot from the Play Store
Step 2: Open Orbot and check VPN Mode and select Full Device VPN

Neutrino Wallet does an excellent job of preventing your peers from learning of your incoming payments. However, outgoing spends are still sent in the clear meaning your remote peers could potentially associate your spends with your IP address. This tutorial will show you how to set up Orbot to enhance the privacy of your spends.
Orbot is now configured and will route Neutrino traffic (and only Neutrino traffic) through Tor when Orbot is running. You can optionally set Orbot to start on boot and run in the background.
Keep your recovery phrase safe. If you ever lose or replace your phone, you can use it to recover your funds.
Never share your recovery phrase with anyone. To be safe, avoid screenshots and don\'t store it on your mobile device.

The Neutrino wallet is part of a larger suite of open source software which helps power the Bitcoin Cash network. The developers donate their time and expertise to bring awesome software to you for free.
Enter bchd nodes, as host or host:port separated by commas, to sync from in SPV mode besides the ones found automatically. Takes effect when the wallet restarts.
